about: Rectitude Holdings Ltd, an investment holding company, engages in the wholesale and supply of safety equipment in Singapore. The company offers personal protective clothing, hand gloves, safety footwear, and personal fall arrest systems; travel restraint products; step platform ladders; portable fire extinguishers and fire related safety products; traffic products, such as rubber speed humps, wheel stops, and wheel chocks; industrial hardware tools, electrical hardware, and accessories for construction sites; and industrial graded hardware products. It also provides rental of AIMS battery energy storage system (BESS) and industrial required machinery; and interlocking paver supply and laying services for construction sites. The company sells its products under the D&D, SkyHawk, Super Sun, STRIKERS, Osprey, HORNET, and DADE brand names. It serves wholesalers, distributors, and end users. Rectitude Holdings Ltd was founded in 1997 and is based in Singapore.
